title: R-F2 OpenTelemetry / OTLP tracing (opt-in `otel` feature)

metrics.notes: Push-based OTLP/HTTP exporter behind the `otel` feature. init_otel_from_env returns Ok(None) without building an exporter when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is unset or blank, so the unconfigured path adds no thread, network call, or dependency cost. Endpoint userinfo/query/fragment are stripped by redacted_endpoint() and the in-memory exporter test asserts no credential attributes are invented. The reqwest-blocking-client feature reuses the workspace reqwest 0.13.4+ dependency instead of adding a second HTTP stack. Traces remain upstream beta, so the dependency is pinned to 0.33.x and must be re-measured before any upgrade.

rationale: Every pre-approved threshold is measured, not asserted: the feature compiles and lints clean, the unconfigured path builds no exporter, redaction is covered by a unit test, and the exporter is exercised against the SDK in-memory exporter under Tokio. ADR-084 records the transport decision.
